title: refactor(ci): consolidate lint/test/release workflows and optimize cache parallelism
author: Maya Chen
description: Summary: Consolidate multiple GitHub Actions workflows (lint, unit test, integration test, and release) into a smaller number of reusable workflow templates to reduce maintenance surface, speed up CI run orchestration, and improve cache parallelism. Motivation: the repo has accumulated ~10 overlapping workflows with duplicated steps and inconsistent caching which increased CI execution time and made cache invalidation fragile. This PR introduces a unified workflow matrix that reuses composite actions for linting and test setup, switches to the centralized build-cache logic, bumps relevant official actions and Node versions, and adjusts job parallelism for faster pipeline completion. Changes include: - extract composite actions: actions/compose-lint, actions/compose-test - unified workflows: .github/workflows/ci.yml (lint + tests + release dispatch), .github/workflows/release.yml (release automation simplified) - caching: standardized cache keys and improved restore/save ordering to reduce misses - parallelism: reduce overly broad parallel job fanout and instead run targeted matrices per package type - dependency bumps: github-actions/toolkit@v5, actions/checkout@v4, setup-node@v4; node 18 -> node 20 where tests are green - hygiene: remove legacy per-repo workflows and inline legacy shell scripts into composite actions Backwards compatibility: existing branch protection rules reference workflow names; migration notes included in PR to coordinate org-level branch protections. Testing: ran full CI matrix on a feature branch, iterated on cache key logic to reduce misses from ~40% to ~6%, and validated release workflow in dry-run mode. See linked Linear tickets: ENG-1423, ENG-1499. Checklist: [x] run full CI matrix locally via act for lint and unit tests [x] verify cache hit ratio improvement on action runs [x] coordinate with SRE on branch protection rename window [x] smoke test release dry-run [x] update dev docs (CONTRIBUTING.md)
